decision: No nonzero additive relation among left/right whiskerings of the 13 R2PURE cycles with coefficient support in B3.
guards: This decides additive group-ring relations supported in the radius-3 ball only.
It does not decide mixed non-additive Peiffer identities or coefficient support radius >=4.
B6 is not opened; this is the R2PURE coefficient-support radius in Gamma_3(2), not the CHIRES B6 search.

left.proof: Repeatedly choose a row supported by exactly one active column; its nonzero integer coefficient is a pivot. Removing that column preserves independence induction. Empty residual core gives a triangular full-column-rank minor over Q.

right.proof: Repeatedly choose a row supported by exactly one active column; its nonzero integer coefficient is a pivot. Removing that column preserves independence induction. Empty residual core gives a triangular full-column-rank minor over Q.
